content:
jordan: Quick heads-up — build v2025.05.19-rc3 is sitting in staging and ready for a promo attempt in the 09:00-10:30 PDT change window. Requesting quick signoffs and rollback plan. @sre-oncall can you confirm capacity in us-west?

deploy-bot: Preflight checks:
- unit tests: OK
- integration tests: OK
- e2e: FLAKY (2/5)
- canary smoke: OK
- infra quotas: OK
Action required: e2e flakiness above threshold.

maya: Saw e2e timeout on payments flow in staging twice within 12m. Stacktrace attached to the PR. +hold until we confirm root cause or a workaround.

sam: If the e2e is a harness flake we can still do a limited canary: 1% in us-west with auto-fallback. Recommend we pin the previous artifact as fallback before any promo.

liz: Agree with limited canary. Also need release notes drafted — I'll put a short draft here.

liz: Release notes draft:
- Feature: streaming improvements — reduced latency ~18%
- Fix: cache invalidation bug for user-profile endpoints
- Known issue: intermittent e2e timeouts on payments in staging; investigating
I'll attach the final notes after QA confirms.

sre-oncall: We have ~2 spare GPU slots for about 1h. Canary 1% looks safe. I'll set routing policy to 1% us-west and keep manual ramp. On fallback we will pin traffic back to v2025.05.12.

jordan: Commands for pin + canary deploy:
```
redwoodctl pin --env prod --artifact v2025.05.12 --note "fallback for rc3"
redwoodctl deploy --canary 1 --region us-west --artifact v2025.05.19-rc3
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment initiated by jordan at 1742553000
- canary: 1% us-west
- monitoring: perf, errors, token-cost
- alerts: error-rate > 0.5% OR latency P95 > 1200ms

emily: I'll watch metrics & create a short dashboard. Will ping on anomalies. @maya can you re-run the failing e2e in staging with an increased timeout?

maya: On it — will re-run in ~10m. If it's a harness flake we can proceed.

deploy-bot: Canary health updates (every 5m):
- 1st check: OK
- 2nd check: error-rate 0.3% (below threshold)
- 3rd check: payment flow timeout observed once, investigating

sam: Seeing a single timeout spike ~5m ago; no user-facing errors. Recommend HOLD on full promo until we get a bit more confidence. +1 to keep canary running.

jordan: Decision for now: HOLD full promotion. Continue canary for 30m, maintain pin to v2025.05.12 as immediate fallback. @emily please approve release note with the known-issue callout.

emily: Approved to proceed with extended canary and release notes callout. I'll add the "Known issue" line to the public notes.

liz: :thumbsup: Preparing PR for release notes and changelog. Checklist:
- [x] draft notes
- [ ] post-deploy validation steps
- [ ] monitoring runbook updates

jordan: Rollback playbook (if needed):
```
redwoodctl rollback --env prod --to v2025.05.12 --reason "rc3 canary regressions"
```

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby for a hot call and to trigger rollback if thresholds breach. Ping me immediately.

maya: Update: re-run of the e2e with extended timeout passed. Looks like a harness flake. I'm OK with promo after the 30m canary if no further spikes.

deploy-bot: Canary 30m summary:
- health: OK
- error-rate: 0.12%
- latency: stable
Ready for manual promotion pending final signoffs.

jordan: Signoffs: @maya +1, @sre-oncall +1, @emily +1, @sam abstain. Proceed to promote at 10:10 PDT. I'll coordinate the lift and update CHANGELOG in #release-notes after promo.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled at 10:10 PDT by jordan. Performing final preflight.

emily: I'll publish release notes and push the public highlights once promo completes.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed at 10:12 PDT. All services healthy. Closing thread.
